"    /**",
"     * Gets a substring of the specified string.",
"     *",
"     * @param str    the string to get the substring from, may be null",
"     * @param start  the position to start from, negative means count back from the end of the string",
"     * @param end    the position to end at (exclusive), negative means count back from the end of the string",
"     * @return substring of the specified string, empty string if null input",
"     */",
"    public static String substring(String str, int start, int end) {",
"        if (str == null) {",
"            return \"\";",
"        }",
"",
"        // Handle negative start and end positions",
"        if (start < 0) {",
"            start = Math.max(str.length() + start, 0);",
"        }",
"        if (end < 0) {",
"            end = Math.max(str.length() + end, 0);",
"        }",
"",
"        // Swap start and end if start is greater than end",
"        if (start > end) {",
"            int temp = start;",
"            start = end;",
"            end = temp;",
"        }",
"",
"        // Adjust end if it is greater than the string length",
"        end = Math.min(end, str.length());",
"",
"        return str.substring(start, end);",
"    }"
]
